Director of Engineering

Anduril Industries
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology.

About The Job

As the Director of Engineering, your role is to provide strategic oversight and tactical management for our engineering teams. In this critical leadership position, you will be responsible for developing new products and enabling the scaling of high-volume production. You will ensure rigorous engineering development processes are in place, driving the consistent delivery of superior quality products.

What You'll Do

  • Own the tactical execution of product development work, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality engineering products.
  • Cultivate a proactive, responsive team culture emphasizing ownership, quality, and appropriate engineering rigor.
  • Set clear goals, objectives, and performance expectations for teams and individuals.
  • Manage and prioritize team resource allocation to effectively support multiple product development programs.
  • Recruit, hire, and retain top-tier engineering talent, providing coaching, mentorship, and career development opportunities.
Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Proven experience (typically 8+ years) in engineering leadership and management roles.
  • Strong background in establishing and optimizing rigorous engineering development processes.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of building, mentoring, and inspiring high-performing engineering teams.
